description: Search bookable sports slots in London across every provider LayUp aggregates. Use when a user wants to find a court, pitch, lane, class or pickup game for football, tennis, squash, padel or swimming. Filter by sport, area/borough, date range, time of day and max price. Returns upcoming slots with venue, London-local time, price, provider and a booking link. Times default to the next 7 days.

area.description: Where to look. Resolved geographically, so any of these work: a borough ('Hackney'), a neighbourhood ('Shoreditch', 'Maida Vale'), a region ('North London', 'Central London'), a postcode or outward code ('W9 2RF', 'SE1'), or a venue name ('Clissold'). Returns venues near the resolved point, not just ones with the word in their name.

booking_type.description: 'spot' = book one place (pickup game / swim seat), 'court' = whole court, 'pitch' = whole pitch.

date_from.description: ISO date or datetime — earliest start. Defaults to now.

date_to.description: ISO date or datetime — latest start. Defaults to 7 days out.

max_price.description: Maximum price in GBP. Published prices above this are removed; unpublished-price slots ('Check App', common for padel/tennis) are kept and flagged.

sport.description: One of Football, Tennis, Squash, Padel, Swimming.

time_from.description: London-local earliest start time of day, 'HH:MM' (e.g. '18:00'). Samples the soonest upcoming slots; combine with date_from to target a specific day.

time_to.description: London-local latest start time of day, 'HH:MM'.

name: search_slots
